talkingPoints.text: even color, water-resistant, easy to remove

benefits.text: BBIA Last Pen Eyeliner has a special design for sharp lines. A round ball inside the pen body helps push the ink for a seamless, even-colored line in just one stroke. The soft, flexible, highly elastic brush tip helps you easily create many different eyeliner styles. The pen is water- and sweat-resistant, keeping lines sharp throughout the day. The special ink properties help make it easy to remove with warm water, extremely convenient.

howToUse.text: Apply a layer of eye primer or concealer before lining your eyes so the color shows up true and lasts longer.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.

sellingPoints.text: Seamless, even-colored line in just one stroke; soft, flexible, highly elastic brush tip; water-resistant, sweat-resistant and easy to remove with warm water.

texture.text: Liquid eyeliner with a soft brush tip, even ink flow.

positioning.text: Liquid eyeliner pen for sharp, seamless, even-colored lines, suited to defined everyday eyeliner.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say absolutely waterproof or 100% smudge-proof. The “throughout the day” claim should be used in the context of normal makeup wear, not extended to absolute long-wear under all conditions.

positioning.text: Liquid eyeliner pen in brown-black for sharp lines that are softer than pure black.

finish.text: Natural matte / soft yet defined / clean line.
